extracted.name: Greek Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Everyone should have this Greek salad dressing in their back pocket! It's super easy to make, and it's zingy, bright, and delicious. Find my favorite ways to use it in the post above.
ingredient_lines: ½ teaspoon dried oregano (more for sprinkling)
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, vinegar, garlic, oregano, mustard, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Use it to make Greek Salad or see many more serving suggestions in the blog post above.
